simple.summary: עֲבָרִים (ʻĂbârîym) means Abarim , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Deut 32 49.

definitions.full: H5682. Abarim עֲבָרִים proper name, of a location 'Abarîm (properly regions beyond river or sea); — usually הָע ׳הַר Num 27:12 ; Deut 32:49 ( = הַלנְֿבוֺ ; both P), and הָע ׳הָרֵי Deuteronomy 33:47 ( נְבוֺ לִפְנֵי ), Deuteronomy 33:48 (P); alone only מֵעֲבָרִים צַעֲקִי Jer 22:20 ; the mountainous district in northwest Moab, just northeast of Dead Sea, GASm Geogr. 548 and EBi Buhl Geogr. 122 ; ᵐ5 Αβαρειμ ( +? ), but τὸ ἐν τῷ πέραν Num 33:47 , εἰς τὸ πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης Jer 22:20 . — See also below עִיִּים .
